name: MiniBooNE
summary: MiniBooNE searched for short-baseline flavour conversion with a mineral-oil Cherenkov detector and produced a persistent low-energy electron-like event excess, as well as many neutrino-interaction measurements.
detection_principle: Photomultiplier tubes in a mineral-oil sphere record Cherenkov and scintillation light. Ring patterns distinguish muon-like tracks from electron-like electromagnetic showers; the detector has limited event-by-event separation between an electron and a photon.

phases.name: Original BooNE two-detector upgrade proposal
phases.description: The 1997 letter of intent considered a later two-detector BooNE configuration after MiniBooNE. That historical upgrade was not the implemented single-detector MiniBooNE exposure, and its proposed geometry must not replace the measured experiment baseline.

results.summary: Reported an electron-like excess in neutrino and antineutrino samples. Its interpretation requires flux, backgrounds and detector response; it is not by itself a unique demonstration of sterile neutrinos.

science_scope: The record describes the named experiment as one programme; detector subsystems and repeated analyses are not counted as independent experiments.
